summary: The filing is an 8-K Item 8.01 Other Events by Deutsche Mortgage Asset Receiving Corporation, as depositor for COMM 2017-COR2 Mortgage Trust, disclosing that effective October 2, 2026, Torchlight Loan Services, LLC replaced Argentic Services Company, L.P. as special servicer for the Colorado Center mortgage loan and its related pari passu and/or subordinate notes in the BXP 2017-CC non-serviced loan combination. Torchlight was appointed at the direction of Aperture Strategic Credit Master Fund, LP, controlling class representative under the applicable servicing agreement. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or closing conditions are stated; servicing remains governed by the existing trust and servicing agreement. Watch for any future specially-serviced status or material-action consent requests.
